variables-and-data-types.description: Variables are named storage locations in memory that hold data. Data types define what operations can be performed on data — integers, floats, booleans, strings and complex types.
interviewQuestions: What is the difference between a primitive and reference type?
How does memory allocation work for different data types?

control-flow-and-logic.description: Control flow determines the order in which statements are executed — conditionals route logic, loops repeat operations, and recursion breaks problems into self-similar subproblems.

functions-and-scope.description: Functions encapsulate reusable logic. Scope determines variable visibility. Closures and higher-order functions are advanced patterns built on these basics.

careers.description: Quantity surveyors estimate costs, prepare bills of quantities, manage contracts and control project finances to ensure construction projects are delivered within budget.

careers.title: Process Engineer
careers.description: Design, optimize and manage chemical and physical processes in manufacturing plants.
careers.tagline: Optimize industrial processes.

careers.title: Process Safety Engineer
careers.description: Ensure safety of chemical processes through hazard analysis, risk assessment and safety systems.
careers.tagline: Keep industrial processes safe.

careers.title: Petrochemical Engineer
careers.description: Design and operate processes for converting petroleum and natural gas into useful products.
careers.tagline: Turn raw materials into products.

careers.title: Bioprocess Engineer
careers.description: Design and scale biotechnological processes for pharmaceutical, food and biofuel production.
careers.tagline: Scale biological processes.

careers.title: Aerodynamics Engineer
careers.description: Analyze and optimize airflow around aircraft, spacecraft and vehicles for performance.
careers.tagline: Shape how things fly.

careers.title: Propulsion Engineer
careers.description: Design and test jet engines, rocket motors and electric propulsion systems.
careers.tagline: Power the vehicles of tomorrow.

careers.title: Avionics Engineer
careers.description: Design electronic systems for aircraft including navigation, communication and flight controls.
careers.tagline: The electronics of flight.

careers.title: Aircraft Design Engineer
careers.description: Design aircraft structures, systems and configurations from concept to production.
careers.tagline: Design the aircraft of tomorrow.

careers.title: Supply Chain Engineer
careers.description: Optimize the flow of goods from raw materials to customers through logistics and planning.
careers.tagline: Keep the supply chain moving.

careers.title: Operations Research Analyst
careers.description: Use mathematical modeling and optimization to solve complex operational problems.
careers.tagline: Optimize with math.

careers.title: Reliability Engineer
careers.description: Ensure products and systems perform reliably throughout their intended lifespan.
careers.tagline: Make things that last.

careers.title: Metallurgical Engineer
careers.description: Study and process metals to improve their properties for engineering applications.
careers.tagline: Transform metals at the atomic level.

careers.title: Materials Scientist
careers.description: Research and develop new materials with specific properties for engineering applications.
careers.tagline: Create the materials of the future.

careers.title: Corrosion Engineer
careers.description: Prevent and manage material degradation through coatings, cathodic protection and material selection.
careers.tagline: Fight material degradation.

careers.title: Polymer Engineer
careers.description: Develop and process polymer materials for automotive, medical and consumer products.
careers.tagline: Engineer plastic materials.

careers.title: Medical Device Engineer
careers.description: Design and develop medical devices from concept through regulatory approval to production.
careers.tagline: Build life-saving devices.

careers.title: Clinical Engineer
careers.description: Manage and maintain medical equipment in hospitals and healthcare facilities.
careers.tagline: Keep medical equipment running.

careers.title: Biomaterials Engineer
careers.description: Develop biocompatible materials for implants, tissue engineering and drug delivery.
careers.tagline: Materials that work with the body.

careers.title: Medical Imaging Engineer
careers.description: Develop and maintain medical imaging systems including MRI, CT, ultrasound and X-ray.
careers.tagline: See inside the human body.

careers.title: Irrigation Engineer
careers.description: Design and manage irrigation systems for efficient water use in agriculture.
careers.tagline: Deliver water where it's needed.

careers.title: Precision Agriculture Specialist
